title: Archbishop Hoban vs. Walsh Jesuit — Football (2025–2026)
summary: Archbishop Hoban Knights vs. Walsh Jesuit Warriors — Holy War football coverage from the 2025–2026 season. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: The Holy War: Hoban and Walsh Jesuit Renew Their Rivalry
article_dek: An Ohio football rivalry with a competitive 2025 regular-season result.
article_body:
Archbishop Hoban defeated Walsh Jesuit 19–14 in their September 26, 2025 regular-season matchup, according to Walsh Jesuit’s published athletic schedule. The narrow result is another chapter in one of Northeast Ohio’s best-known school rivalries.

The score tells only part of the story. School pride, intensity on the field and the anticipation around each meeting shape the Holy War’s atmosphere. Mason Bybee’s gallery documents the players and moments from the rivalry.
